structure: a tall vertical cutaway cross-section of a film production studio building in the centre of a portrait canvas, with a giant blank clapperboard and a film reel on its roof.
character: young film intern (a white man in his early 20s, curly brown hair, grey beanie, utility vest)
scenes: he arrives with a coffee and loads kit cases, a camera, a tripod and lights onto a trolley.
he holds a boom microphone over two actors on a small set beside a camera operator.
he labels memory cards and notes takes on a clipboard at a kit cart.
he sits at an editing desk with a timeline of coloured abstract blocks across two monitors.
he watches the cut with the team in a small screening room with popcorn; dusk through the window.
props: a giant film reel, a blank clapperboard, a director's chair, a spotlight, popcorn, headphones, a film strip

steps.title: On set
steps.body: Help the crew capture each scene.

steps.title: Log the footage
steps.body: Label cards and note the best takes.

steps.title: Edit
steps.body: Build the clips into a rough cut.

steps.title: Review
steps.body: Watch the cut and take notes.
